strategy_checks.check: Noivern chooses Tailwind when it creates a Tyrantrum turn
strategy_checks.evidence: T1 chose Tailwind (Fake Out flinched it); T2 with Tyrantrum already dead it switched to Draco Meteor into Urshifu (broke the Sash) instead of a now-pointless Tailwind - exactly the conditional the plan describes.

strategy_checks.check: Tyrantrum attacks turn 1 (Strong Jaw / Rock Slide)
strategy_checks.evidence: T1 chose Rock Slide; OHKOed by Close Combat (2x) before moving.

strategy_checks.check: Mega Dragonite dances or Extreme Speeds; Multiscale removed by chip before the dance
strategy_checks.evidence: T3 Dragonite Mega Evolved and used Dragon Dance behind Druddigon's Protect while my Knock Off took it to 233/273 (Multiscale spent). T4 +1 Dragon Claw KOed Incineroar; Moonblast then removed it. Extreme Speed never chosen because the only remaining targets were Ghost/Fairy - correct.

strategy_checks.check: Druddigon Sheer Force coverage / Haban Berry
strategy_checks.result: PASS (Sheer Force Rock Slide) / NOT EXERCISED (Haban: Knock Off removed it, and no Dragon move was used)
strategy_checks.evidence: T2 Rock Slide finished sashed Urshifu and hit Incineroar 2x; T4 Rock Slide KOed Incineroar.

protect_ledger.payoff: REAL - blocked Flutter Mane's Moonblast (2x) while Mega Dragonite Dragon Danced for free. Textbook partner-cover Protect.

protect_ledger.entry: Noivern and Dragonite carry Protect and did not use it; no empty Protects.

cooler: The four-dragon spread plays well: the Tailwind-or-attack conditional fired correctly, the Protect covered the dance, and the dance produced a KO. Two faints, keep. What the fight lacks is any way for the Dragons to touch a Ghost/Fairy - once Flutter Mane is on the field, Mega Dragonite has literally no legal damaging move against it (Dragon Claw, Extreme Speed both blanked). A Fire or Steel coverage move on Dragonite (not this pass) would close that hole.
authored_set_legality: No problem; all four sets played as written and Dragonite Mega Evolved on T3.
